host_environment_notes.new_freeze_rule: Corrected in this new handoff (R3 report retained in place). Original preflight archive is Linux 6.8.0-149, Python 3.13.5, SciPy 1.15.3, NumPy 2.1.3. Subsequent execution is governed by the actual new freeze environment. No new freeze is generated in this turn.

GP5-P2-R3-MONITOR-BINDING-01.summary: Removed historical EXPECTED_MONITOR_DIGEST constant from driver.py. bind_runtime_monitor_snapshot loads monitor_snapshot.json from the explicit --runtime directory and verifies its raw file reference (path inside runtime and SHA-256), startup_review_request.json (monitor_digest and monitor_reference), independent launch record (monitor_digest and optional monitor_reference), and actual monitor algorithm_identity structure/digests, while preserving host dependency/config/source checks in validate_monitor_snapshot and preflight_order. Regression proves a temporary snapshot whose digest differs from the historical value enters the 4-config preflight, and any reference or identity drift aborts with 0 dispatches.

GP5-P2-R3-LEGACY-COMPLETION-01.summary: geometry_kernel_completion.validate_completion now explicitly distinguishes ordinary legacy recovery records from phase-snapshot recovery records by recovery protocol and credential mode (is_native(plan) with durable_root, [STARTED, RETURNED] invocation history, explicit phase_credential reference, or presence of phase_snapshot_credential.json). Legacy v16 ordinary recovery records carrying durable_root retain baseline acceptance behavior; phase-snapshot recovery records must verify phase_snapshot_credential.json and retained parent final record.json and accounting.json. Added contrastive regressions proving legacy v16 durable_root records pass while new phase-snapshot records missing credentials or with drifted parent evidence are rejected.

GP5-P2-R3-HOST-NOTES-01.summary: Corrected host environment baseline in the new handoff and report to match archived host_preflight.json (Linux 6.8.0-149, Python 3.13.5, SciPy 1.15.3, NumPy 2.1.3), noting that future new freeze will use the actual new freeze environment. No new freeze generated in this turn; prior R3 report retained untouched.

GP5-P2-R2-PARENT-EVIDENCE-01.summary: Retained parent primary run final accounting.json and record.json verification on disk via read_reference at both recovery entrypoint and completion review.

GP5-P2-R2-RUNTIME-INPUT-01.summary: Explicit --runtime CLI directory check and dynamic monitor snapshot binding pass offline verification; historical runtime directory, stale source_identity, wrong directory, missing files, and historical authorization paths are rejected before first dispatch.

GP5-P2-DRIVER-DISPATCH-01.summary: Retained 4 primary + 6 recovery dispatches (10 total run_order_job invocations) tested with a new-digest monitor snapshot; all 6 recovery outputs and completion receipt pass real validate_saved_checkpoint and validate_completion.

GP5-P2-DRIVER-AUTH-01.summary: Retained independent authorization path and SHA-256 binding and rejections before 4-job config preflight and dispatch.

GP5-P2-DRIVER-LEDGER-01.summary: Retained initial zero-ledger barrier, in-run incremental check_counts, and final 6+2=8 assessment coverage check.
